text: Palbociclib is a highly selective, reversible inhibitor of cyclin-dependent kinases 4 and 6 (CDK4/6). In HR-positive breast cancer, it binds to the ATP-binding pocket of CDK4, preventing the phosphorylation of the retinoblastoma (Rb) protein and thereby arresting the cell cycle at the G1-to-S phase transition. This mechanism effectively halts the uncontrolled proliferation characteristic of hormone receptor-positive malignant cells.
